title: 1995 AMC 8 Problem 8
statement: An American traveling in Italy wishes to exchange American money (dollars) for Italian money (lire). If \(3000\) lire \(= \$1.60,\) how many lire will the traveler receive in exchange for \(\$1.00?\)

solutions.text:
Since \(\$1.00\) is \(\dfrac{1.00}{1.60} = \dfrac58\) of \(\$1.60,\) the traveler gets \(\dfrac58\) of \(3000\) lire.

That is \(\dfrac58 \times 3000 = 1875\) lire.

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: Find how many lire equal one dollar using the given rate
